generation.method: Recorded verbatim from one read-only live gh api graphql call. No value was entered by hand.
generation.producer: gh api graphql -F owner=<repository-owner> -F name=<repository-name> -f query=<query>

states.2484: open, level with its base; checks still run and no review check exists
states.2487: merged; every check passed and the review check succeeded at its head
states.2488: open, stacked on the head branch of another open pull request, whose base has no protection rule
states.2489: open, behind its base by one commit with a merge conflict; every check passes, the review check succeeded, no thread
states.2491: open, behind its base; the review check failed and two threads are unresolved
